description: Procurement for the Supply and Installation of Oracle Exadata System and related Software Licenses for the Sri Lanka Customs
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-09 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024-08-21 to implement the procurement for the selection of an appropriate institution for the supply of Oracle Exadata System and related Software Licenses for the Sri Lanka Customs. Accordingly, bids have been invited following the national competitive bidding procedure, and three (03) bids have been received for the same. After evaluating the financial bid of the only technically qualified bidder among the said bids, based on the recommendations submitted by the High Level Procurement Committee, the proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to award the said procurement, to Millennium I.T.E.S.P. (Private) Limited for a period of 08 years for a sum of Rs.2,197.96 million (Excluding Taxes), was approved by the Cabinet of Ministers.
